questions_and_decisions.question: Can changing TMPDIR alone satisfy policy?
questions_and_decisions.decision: No. StateDirectory backing, private tmp creation and artifact staging also require proof.

questions_and_decisions.question: May isolation be disabled to relocate work?
What if mount/unmount reply is lost?
questions_and_decisions.decision: Persist exclusive intent; do not replay; report uncertain and reconcile.

questions_and_decisions.question: Can systemd255 branch prove runtime behavior?
questions_and_decisions.decision: No. Pin actual package and observe real unit, tmp events, mountinfo, dev/inode, ownership lifecycle.
